title: 7-round AES-256: collision-based selected-round-key recovery

target.description: Seven-round AES-256, initial whitening and final MixColumns omitted. The explicit procedure returns192 bits of selected round-key material:32 whitening-key bits, all128 bits of the permuted round7 key, and32 bits of the transformed round6 key. A complete master-key reconstruction and its cost are not specified.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key. The article explicitly omits the key schedule from its attack derivation.
setting.key_population: general secret key; no restriction to a weak-key family
setting.plaintext_model: One2^32 chosen-plaintext structure varying diagonal bytes P00,P11,P22,P33 with all other bytes fixed; internal set construction has a documented source discrepancy.
assumptions: The source uses a birthday model for a32-bit internal tuple and a25-sample independent wrong-key match heuristic.
The explicit key-material output is retained. The paper does not detail a full master-key completion procedure or the cost of the Step4 cross-table matching search.
Section2.3 Step3 reverses the within/across-set description for the three parameter bytes relative to Section2.2; both statements are documented.

time.note: Source total headline is justified by Step2 table filling. Sorting, Step4 cross-table candidate matching and master-key completion are not individually costed; no independently verified end-to-end bound is claimed.

memory.note: Native reported table-storage expression; explicit table-index, sorting-workspace and whole-key completion overheads are not itemized.

preprocessing.reported: Ciphertext-dependent Step2 tables; included in the source's2^69.2 time headline
preprocessing.note: This is input-dependent table generation, not a reusable key-independent offline table or an additional independent budget.

success.description: No numerical selected192-bit round-key-material recovery success is given. The internal collision estimate and fixed-witness false-match probability do not quantify the four-column procedure. Preserve both existing internal-set and search-wide witness conflicts; no product of collision marginals or complete-master-key success is assigned.

components.description: Section2.2: sampling2^16 distinct internal triples among2^32 function descriptions has about one-half collision probability in the source birthday model. This is one internal collision, not joint multi-column recovery.

Section2.2 Equation5: the source uniform per-input2^-8 model gives2^-200 for25 tests of a fixed wrong guess and fixed pair. Search-wide pair-witness multiplicity and the internal projected-set construction remain unresolved.

review.scope: Independent source-first and endpoint review, PDF2–5: whole selected192-bit-round-key-material success is not quantified. About0.5 is an internal projected-function birthday estimate; fixed-witness2^-200 is not a search-wide key-output law. Four-column joint success, pair-witness multiplicity and the internal set conflict remain. No0.5^4, corrected false-key probability or master-key completion is inferred. Targeted review does not change complete-paper audit gates or close the original missing-success objective.

limitations: Full attack search, total complexity and success probability are not independently reproduced. Component identity checks are documented separately.
Step4 combination/matching complexity remains unitemized. The2^69.2 figure is the author's reported headline, not a verified total or best-known claim.
The192 returned round-key bits are not automatically identified with a192-bit master key and do not by themselves constitute the256-bit AES-256 master key.
Full exact-edition inventory checked; numerical attack execution is not claimed.

field_conflicts.label: Internal set construction
field_conflicts.description: Section2.2 varies I2_00 while fixing a parameter triple within each function. Step3 says the corresponding three X parameter bytes vary within each set and are the same across all sets, reversing those roles.

observations.reported: For a fixed parameter triple, the equality is tested over active I2_00 values; distinct parameter triples are sought.
X10,X20,X30 are described as different in each set but the same in all sets.

field_conflicts.label: Search-wide key-pair witness multiplicity
field_conflicts.description: Printed2^192*2^-200 covers one fixed pair of structures. If all unordered pairs among2^16 structures are searched, under that same per-key/per-fixed-pair2^-200 model the expected wrong-key/pair witness count is2^192*C(2^16,2)*2^-200=8,388,480 (log2≈23), not2^-8. This is neither a distinct-wrong-key count nor an actual AES false-positive probability; its expectation alone does not establish high error probability. No corrected whole-attack success/time is inferred.

observations.reported: 2^16 structures; choose two distinct structures for the collision search.
